records.name: Russell E. Gregg Memorial Scholarship

records.recurrenceNote: Provider describes spring and winter awards annually; verify each new application window.

Payment destination is not stated on the checked pages; confirm it before accepting an award. The Southern Arizona question concerns a separate grant, not eligibility for the general scholarship.
records.recurrenceNote: Board describes twice-yearly selection; confirm the next cutoff rather than assuming dates.

records.name: NATA Business Scholarship
records.requirements: Age 18+; employee of a NATA member company, nominated and endorsed by a Regular or Associate member-company representative. Part 147 or Part 65 aircraft-maintenance education is expressly eligible; no university degree is required for this training route. NJ applicants may qualify through eligible employment.
records.note: Deadline is the last Friday in December (December 25 in 2026). Two recommendations and a career-goal essay/résumé are required. Check is payable jointly to the student and training institute, not unrestricted cash. Pilot/medical requirements apply to flight applicants, not the maintenance route. Employment is a prerequisite, not an award benefit.
records.recurrenceNote: Provider specifies an annual last-Friday-in-December deadline; recheck the live form.

records.name: Continuing Education Scholarship
records.requirements: Age 21+ by February 15, 2027. Current VFW Auxiliary member, or the spouse, son or daughter of a current member; qualifying membership must reach one year by the deadline. Vocational/technical school is eligible nationwide, including NJ. Prior degree/major restrictions are not stated on the checked page; previous national winners are excluded.
records.note: Four national awards, one per conference. Application is in MALTA Member Resources → Scholarships. Current 2026–27 rules say funds go to the school and prohibit generative-AI essay content. Essay is up to 300 words. Veteran status alone does not satisfy the Auxiliary membership condition.
records.recurrenceNote: Annual July 1–February 15 cycle; verify the latest member application.

records.name: Trade School Scholarship
records.requirements: Enrolled member of a federally recognized American Indian/Alaska Native tribe/entity or direct descendant of a base-roll member. Accredited U.S. technical/trade school, including eligible NJ schools; at least 6 credits, GPA 2.25 after the first term, FAFSA and financial need. No earned degrees; maximum 150 semester or 210 quarter credits.
records.note: January award applications run September 1–November 1 for the spring/winter or equivalent term. Send required documents through the provider portal; no emailed documents. Funds go to the school after approval and a thank-you letter. The application requires JavaScript; confirm the live portal accepts your program’s credit/term structure. Award amount is not published on the checked official page.
records.recurrenceNote: Two stated cycles: September award (May 1–July 1) and January award (September 1–November 1).

records.name: Next Chapter Scholarship
records.requirements: Women age 18+ pursuing career change, workforce return or advancement. Accredited trade/vocational and workforce-certificate programs are eligible, along with associate’s/bachelor’s study. Provider describes nationwide reach; Royal Neighbors membership is not required. Master’s/doctoral programs are excluded; holding an earlier degree is not stated as an exclusion.
records.note: Fall cycle supports winter/spring education, with payment in January. Preference is direct school payment; no living or transport expenses. For a program costing $2,500 or less in a year, funding covers up to 80%. Confirm your AIM enrollment, term and program expenses with the provider. Apply through its YourCause portal; account creation may be required.
records.recurrenceNote: Published cycles: April 1–June 1 and October 1–November 15; timing may change.

records.name: Union Plus Scholarship
records.requirements: Current/retired members of participating unions, their spouses or IRS-dependent children; at least one continuous year of membership by May 31, 2027. records.note: Current application due January 31, 2027, 11:59 p.m. Eastern, for study beginning fall 2027. General award is monetary, but exact payment handling should be confirmed in the application. No purchase of a Union Plus financial product is required. Grandchildren qualify only if legal dependents. Confirm school enrollment extends into the award period.
records.recurrenceNote: Annual application; previous applicants can reapply under current terms.

records.name: Doris Buffett Independence Scholar Grant
records.requirements: Survivors of intimate-partner abuse residing in the U.S., including NJ, who are U.S. citizens/permanent residents; separated from the abuser for 1–10 years, with critical financial need. Accredited technical/vocational programs and any major can qualify; for-profit schools are considered at lowest funding priority. Prior degree holders are not automatically excluded; first-undergraduate students receive preference.
records.note: Current fall cycle has ended; provider announces the next January 1–March 1 application window. Confirm 2027 portal availability before applying. Professional and personal recommendations, financial documentation and an academic plan are required. Awards are based on enrollment; payment route needs confirmation. Sensitive personal details go only to the provider, never to this directory.
records.recurrenceNote: Published application cycles are August 1–October 1 and January 1–March 1. Opening month is a next-cycle watch, not an open application.

maintenancePolicy.expired: Hide closed/expired awards unless recurring or a future opening is recorded. Deadline date remains included.
maintenancePolicy.missing: Hide confirmed HTTP 404/410 sources; recheck all hidden URLs on every run and restore after a successful content check.
maintenancePolicy.transient: 403/429/timeouts/5xx do not count as permanent disappearance.
maintenancePolicy.discovery: New maintenance-related headings on maintained official sources become unverified leads.
maintenancePolicy.eligibilityScope: Judge applicant eligibility, not provider headquarters. Exclude awards restricted to non-NJ residents or schools when NJ applicants cannot qualify. Current AIM NJ pre-A&P certificate students are the primary audience.
